name: Additive
description: An additive plan for the fuel: a rotation that moves on with every refuel (for example clean - additive 1 - clean - additive 2), a reminder when the range gets low, and a history. Optional, off until you set it up.
author: Matze89x

docs: Keeps an additive plan for the fuel: the plan moves on with every refuel (default: clean, additive 1, clean, additive 2), reminds you on the home page when the range gets low, and keeps a history you can mark as added / not added. Names and amounts are yours; nothing is sold or recommended.
